item.text:
### (a) Three social posts

1. We know what is at stake: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, humanity will permanently lose control of its future. We must prevent that outcome—not race toward it.

2. We refuse to trade humanity’s future for a race to superintelligence. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, we will permanently lose control. No promise of progress justifies that irreversible loss.

3. We believe humanity must remain in charge of its future. Building superintelligent AI within the next 20 years will end that control permanently. We demand action to stop that future before it becomes our reality.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We face a choice that will determine whether humanity remains in control of its future. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, we will permanently lose that control. We cannot accept this outcome, and we will not treat it as the unavoidable price of progress. Our future is not something to surrender to systems more powerful than we are. We must stop the race toward superintelligence and insist on enforceable limits that protect human agency. That means organising now, demanding accountability, and rejecting promises that ask us to gamble away everything. We stand for a future humanity can still choose—and we intend to defend it.
